title: Don’t Forget to Return a Kindness
synopsis: This useful Chinese idiom teaches us that it is important to be grateful and return kindness.

fullText.simplified:
知恩图报

    中国人常说：“要知恩图报！好人有好报！”最近，就有这样“知恩图报”的人，给了“好人”好报”。
    1987年，14岁的孙胜容在理发店里做洗头工，24岁的张爱民是那个理发店的常客。聊着聊着，孙胜容和张爱民成了好朋友。当时，孙胜容在理发店里工作得很不开心，他想自己开一个理发店。张爱民知道后，拿出自己一年的工资1000元帮他开了一个理发店。几年后，两人因为没有联系方式而断了联系。后来，孙胜容到海外创业，赚了很多钱。成功后的孙胜容一直记得张爱民的恩情，他想找到张爱民，他想报恩。最近，他终于找到了张爱民。为了报恩，他想送给张爱民两套房子，但遭到了拒绝。于是，他决定投资1000万元给张爱民开酒庄。
    张爱民是个好人，孙胜容是个知恩图报的人，他给了张爱民“好报”，他们一起成就了这段佳话。
fullText.traditional:
知恩圖報

    中國人常說：“要知恩圖報！好人有好報！”最近，就有這樣“知恩圖報”的人，給了“好人”好報”。
    1987年，14歲的孫勝容在理髮店裡做洗頭工，24歲的張愛民是那個理髮店的常客。聊著聊著，孫勝容和張愛民成了好朋友。當時，孫勝容在理髮店裡工作得很不開心，他想自己開一個理髮店。張愛民知道後，拿出自己一年的工資1000元幫他開了一個理髮店。幾年後，兩人因為沒有聯繫方式而斷了聯繫。後來，孫勝容到海外創業，賺了很多錢。成功後的孫勝容一直記得張愛民的恩情，他想找到張愛民，他想報恩。最近，他終於找到了張愛民。為了報恩，他想送給張愛民兩套房子，但遭到了拒絕。於是，他決定投資1000萬元給張愛民開酒莊。
    張愛民是個好人，孫勝容是個知恩圖報的人，他給了張愛民“好報”，他們一起成就了這段佳話。

raw.synopsis: This useful Chinese idiom teaches us that it is important to be grateful and return kindness.
sentence_translations: Don’t Forget to Return a Kindness
Chinese people often say: “It’s important to repay kindness! Good things come to good people!”
Recently, just this kind of a “don’t forget to return kindness” person, gave a “good person” a “good return”.
In 1987, 14-year-old Sun Shengrong worked as a hair washer in a barber shop.
24-year-old Zhang Aimin was a regular customer at that barber shop.
Chatting, Sun Shengrong and Zhang Aimin became good friends.
At that time, Sun Shengrong was very unhappy working at the barber shop.
He wanted to open a barber shop himself.
After Zhang Aimin learned this, he took out a year’s salary of 1000 yuan to help him open a barber shop.
A few years later, the two lost contact because they didn’t have any contact details.
Later, Sun Shengrong went to start an enterprise abroad, and made a lot of money.
After his success, Sun Shengrong always remembered Zhang Aimin’s kindness.
He wanted to find Zhang Aimin and wanted to return the favor.
Recently, he finally found Zhang Aimin.
In order to repay the kindness, he wanted to give Zhang Aimin two apartments, but was met with rejection.
So, he decided to invest 10 million yuan for Zhang Aimin to open a winery.
Zhang Aimin is a good person, Sun Shengrong is a person that remembers and returns kindness.
He gave Zhang Aimin a “good return” and they achieved this widely praised story together.
